summary: The design proposes extending V2ProjectionSource.selectActions and existing Core/GitHub/CLI boundaries, preserving native issues/Project3 planning and original journals rather than adding a competing scheduler. Existing OperationObservation and ContextView supply bounded continuation and compact context; registered V2Preflight checks remain authoritative. Readiness never grants authority. Ordinary isolated verification and finite protected owner sequences follow ADR0096; ADR0084 coherent validation and ADR0097 serialized publication remain unchanged until qualified policy changes. Typed observed/attested/reported facts, exact joins, scoped Unknown/conflicts, original uncertain-effect observation and explicit liveness tests govern the proposed extension. Source design is a proposal, not deployed behavior or runtime admission; implementation requires normal intake, source/CI, publication, exact installed adoption, recovery/rollback and a measured pilot.
title: Extend the canonical F# selector with owner continuation
